messages.subject: Estimate for the smoothing function
parts:
I generated data from a poison distribution as follow

 

Y_ij ~ Poisson (beta_0+beta_1x+g(t_ij) + b_i)

 

g(t_ij) is a function of time which have some specified form for example a sin function and b_i normally distributed random effect. I fit a rw2 model for the generated data as follow:

 

f=y~-1+x+f(time, model="rw2",prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.0005),cyclic = TRUE)  +f(id,model="iid",prior="loggamma”)

 

m = inla(f,  data = Simdata, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1), family="poisson", control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE))

 

Then, I want to calculate the mean squared error (MSE) of the estimated function ^g(r). For this which component of m should I monitor?

m$marginals.random$time

Or something else?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Estimate for the smoothing function
parts:
maybe its easier to look at m$summary.random$time

?

H
